name: Dale Davis
residence: Sweetwater County (he wrote that the county has long been his home)
occupation: Sweetwater County clerk-elect taking office in January 2027; in a 2026 Green River Star voter-guide statement he wrote that he was then chief deputy clerk of Laramie County
prior_offices: Sweetwater County clerk, 2007 to early 2019 (his 2026 Green River Star voter-guide statement)
background: Dale Davis is the Sweetwater County clerk-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Cindy Lane-Swenson, who is serving through the current term. In an August 2026 Green River Star voter-guide statement he wrote that he began in the Sweetwater County Clerk's Office in 1991, worked in the title and accounting and payroll departments, served as Sweetwater County clerk from 2007 to early 2019, and has since served as chief deputy clerk in Laramie County. He won the August 18, 2026, Republican primary over the incumbent and was unopposed in the November general election.
